answer_1.quote: In this work, we aim to reduce the presence of translationese in human-translated texts and make them closely resemble original texts, notably, without using any parallel data... We approach the challenge as a monolingual translation-based style transfer task.
answer_1.outputs: Style-transferred outputs (ôg) that resemble original texts while preserving semantic content

answer_2.quote: We compute three metrics: Acc. (Translationese Classification Accuracy), BERTScore (BERT-F1) and Perplexity (PPL)... Additionally, mean per-word entropy is computed over the style-transferred output... TTR and LD scores.
